verdict.rationale: Google's first-party Infrastructure Manager docs say you can define Google Cloud infrastructure declaratively with Terraform and create preview deployments before applying changes. That implies a working Terraform surface for Google Cloud resources, but nothing names the provider itself or shows its maintenance or release status. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a vendor-maintained Terraform/OpenTofu provider, evidence of active release cadence, documented coverage of core services, OpenTofu compatibility, independent or hands-on corroboration.
